overall_goal: Drain, season, and mash the boiled potatoes

goals.description: Drain the boiled potatoes and transfer them to a plate
goals.rationale: The person drains the water from the saucepan using a colander and pours the boiled potatoes onto a plate.

goals.description: Add butter and horseradish to the potatoes and stir
goals.rationale: The person cuts a slab of butter, opens the horseradish tub, adds both ingredients to the potatoes, and stirs them together.

goals.description: Mash the potatoes and return stray chunks to the plate
goals.rationale: The person begins mashing the potatoes with a masher, scrapes the masher clean, and picks up pieces of potato that fell onto the counter.

goals.description: Finish mashing and stir the potatoes to mix the ingredients
goals.rationale: The person continues mashing the potatoes, cleans up the remaining stray pieces, and gives the mash a final stir to ensure it is well mixed.
